questions_and_answers.question_text: Du schreibst doch den Brief, nicht wahr?

answers.answer_text: You're going to write the letter, aren't you?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Du gehst doch zur Post, nicht wahr?

answers.answer_text: You're going to the post office, aren't you?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Du holst doch die Schuhe ab, nicht wahr?

answers.answer_text: You're going to pick up the shoes, aren't you?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Du gibst ihm das Geld doch, nicht wahr?

answers.answer_text: You're going to give him the money, aren't you?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Du fährst doch in die Stadt, nicht wahr?

answers.answer_text: You're driving downtown, aren't you?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Ihr kommt zu spät.

answers.answer_text: You're late.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Ihr lest zu viel.

answers.answer_text: You read too much.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Ihr erreicht ihn heute nicht.

answers.answer_text: You won't reach him today.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Ihr fragt zuviel.

answers.answer_text: You ask too many questions ('too much').

questions_and_answers.question_text: Ihr arbeitet nicht genug.

answers.answer_text: You don't work enough.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Ihr seid etwas überlastet.

answers.answer_text: You are somewhat loaded down.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Ich treffe dich morgen hier.

answers.answer_text: I'll meet you (sg) here tomorrow.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wir nehmen euch heute abend mit.

answers.answer_text: We'll take you (pl) with us tonight.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Ich hole dich kurz vor acht Uhr ab.

answers.answer_text: I'll pick you (sg) up shortly before eight o'clock.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Sie erwartet euch um sechs.

answers.answer_text: She's expecting you (pl) at six.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Er ruft dich heute nachmittag an.

answers.answer_text: He'll call you (sg) this afternoon.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wir brauchen Sie morgen nicht, Fräulein Becker.

answers.answer_text: We don't need you tomorrow, Miss Becker.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Sie wäscht sich gerade die Hände.

answers.answer_text: She's just washing her hands.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Ich kämme mir die Haare.

answers.answer_text: I'm combing my hair.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Kauft ihr euch einen neuen Wagen?

answers.answer_text: Are you buying yourselves a new car?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Schneidest du dir die Haare selbst?

answers.answer_text: Do you cut your hair yourself?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Willst du dir mein kleines Radio leihen?

answers.answer_text: Do you want to borrow my little radio?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wollt ihr euch die Hände waschen?

answers.answer_text: Do you (all) want to wash your hands?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Geht ihr auch zum Vortrag?

answers.answer_text: Are you going to the lecture too?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Kommt ihr auch zum Konzert?

answers.answer_text: Are you coming to the concert too?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Bleibt ihr auch in der Stadt?

answers.answer_text: Are you staying down town too?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Esst ihr auch im Restaurant?

answers.answer_text: Are you eating at the restaurant too?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Kauft ihr auch in diesem Geschäft?

answers.answer_text: Do you buy at this store too?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wohnt ihr auch im Vorort?

answers.answer_text: Do you live in the suburbs too?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Ist das eure Zeitung?

answers.answer_text: Is that your newspaper?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Habt ihr ein Telephon in eurem Zimmer?

answers.answer_text: Do you have a telephone in your room?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Besucht ihr eure Eltern oft?

answers.answer_text: Do you visit your parents often?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Ist das die Adresse eures Hotels?

answers.answer_text: Is that the address of your hotel?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Euer neues Auto gefällt mir wirklich gut.

answers.answer_text: I really like your new car.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wohnt Herr Schneider auch in eurem Etagenhaus?

answers.answer_text: Does Mr. Schneider live in your apartment house too?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Das ist wirklich ein schöner Mantel. Ist das deiner?

answers.answer_text: That really is a beautiful coat. Is it yours?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Das ist aber ein kleines Auto. Ist das eures?

answers.answer_text: My, but that's a small car. Is it yours (pl)?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Das sind aber schöne Schuhe. Sind das deine?

answers.answer_text: My, but those are nice-looking shoes. Are they yours (sg)?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Das ist wirklich ein warmer Mantel. Ist das deiner?

answers.answer_text: That really is a warm coat. Is it yours (sg)?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Das sind aber kurze Jacken. Sind das eure?

answers.answer_text: My, but those are short jackets. Are they yours (pl)?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Das ist aber ein altes Buch. Ist das deins?

answers.answer_text: My, but that's an old book. Is it yours (sg)?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Das ist wirklich eine schöne Krawatte. Ist das deine?

answers.answer_text: That really is a nice tie. Is it yours (sg)?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Komm' schnell nach Hause.

answers.answer_text: Come home quickly.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Vergiss die Schuhe nicht.

answers.answer_text: Don't forget the shoes.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Geh' erst zum Schuster.

answers.answer_text: Go to the shoemaker's first.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nimm den blauen Anzug mit.

answers.answer_text: Take the blue suit with you.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Kämm' dir die Haare.

answers.answer_text: Comb your hair.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wasch' dir die Hände.

answers.answer_text: Wash your hands.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wisst ihr, dass wir bald nach Deutschland fahren?

answers.answer_text: Do you know that we're going to Germany soon?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wisst ihr, ob der Schulausflug morgen stattfindet?

answers.answer_text: Do you know whether the school outing is tomorrow?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Hofft ihr auch, dass Meyers bald abfahren?

answers.answer_text: Are you hoping too that the Meyers leave soon?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Glaubt ihr, dass die Konferenz morgen anfängt?

answers.answer_text: Do you believe that the conference is going to begin tomorrow?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Denkt ihr, dass die Sekretärin das übersetzen kann?

answers.answer_text: Do you think that the secretary can translate that?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Erwartet ihr, dass sie euch besuchen?

answers.answer_text: Do you expect that they will visit you?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Findest du nicht auch, dass die Wohnung sehr teuer ist?

answers.answer_text: Don't you think too that the apartment is very expensive?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Glaubst du, dass wir zu spät kommen?

answers.answer_text: Do you think ('believe') that we're late?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Sagst du ihm, dass er zur Besprechung kommen möchte?

answers.answer_text: Are you going to tell him that you want him to come to the conference?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Weisst du, ob er zur Handelskammer geht?

answers.answer_text: Do you know whether he's going to the Chamber of Commerce?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Denkst du, dass das Auto noch kaputt ist?

answers.answer_text: Do you think that the car is still out of order?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Erwartest du, dass er bald anruft?

answers.answer_text: Do you expect that he's going to call up soon?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Lassen Sie diesen Artikel doch übersetzen, Herr Meyer.

answers.answer_text: Have this article translated, Mr. Meyer.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Lass diese Oberhemden bitte waschen.

answers.answer_text: Have these shirts washed, please (fam sg).

questions_and_answers.question_text: Lasst die Schuhe auch besohlen.

answers.answer_text: Have the shoes soled too (fam pl).

questions_and_answers.question_text: Lass dir die Haare bitte schneiden.

answers.answer_text: Have your hair cut, please (fam sg).

questions_and_answers.question_text: Lassen Sie die Wohnung bitte auch sauhermachen.

answers.answer_text: Have the apartment cleaned too, please, Mrs. Köhler.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Du musst den Artikel übersetzen lassen.

answers.answer_text: You (fam sg) will have to have the article translated.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Ihr könnt die Wäsche abholen lassen.

answers.answer_text: You (fam pl) can have the laundry picked up.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Sie sollen die Formulare ausfüllen lassen.

answers.answer_text: They're supposed to have the forms filled out.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Ich muss mir die Schuhe besohlen lassen.

answers.answer_text: I have to have my shoes soled.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Sie will den Reifen wechseln lassen.

answers.answer_text: She wants to have the tire changed.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Hol' doch bitte die Schuhe beim Schuster ab.

answers.answer_text: Pick up the shoes at the shoemaker's please.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Geh' doch bitte zur Post und hol' zehn Briefmarken.

answers.answer_text: Go to the post office and get ten stamps, please.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Erwarte uns nicht zu früh.

answers.answer_text: Don't expect us too early.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nimm doch diese Briefe mit zur Post.

answers.answer_text: Take these letters along with you to the post office.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Stell' bitte das Radio an.

answers.answer_text: Turn the radio on, please.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Gib mir doch bitte mal Gerhards Telephonnummer.

answers.answer_text: Please give me Gerhard's telephone number.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Seid nicht so langsam, sonst verpasst ihr noch die Strassenbahn.

answers.answer_text: Don't be so slow, or else you miss the streetcar.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Seid bitte um viertel sechs bei uns.

answers.answer_text: Please be at our house at quarter past five (fam pl).

questions_and_answers.question_text: Bitte sei heute abend um sieben Uhr bei mir.

answers.answer_text: Please be at MY house tonight at seven o'clock (fam sg).

questions_and_answers.question_text: Sei ruhig, Vater arbeitet.

answers.answer_text: Be quiet; father's working (fam sg).

questions_and_answers.question_text: Seien Sie bitte um neun Uhr dreissig bei mir, Herr König.

answers.answer_text: Please be at my place at nine-thirty, Mr. König.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Sei nett zu deinem Freund, Klaus.

answers.answer_text: Be nice to your friend, Klaus!

questions_and_answers.question_text: Seien Sie bitte ruhig, meine Herren; nebenan ist eine wichtige Besprechung.

answers.answer_text: Please be quiet, gentlemen; there's an important conference next door.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Er muss heute nachmittag zur Bank.

answers.answer_text: He has to go to the bank this afternoon.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Ich möchte morgen gern in die Stadt.

answers.answer_text: I'd like to go downtown tomorrow.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Ich muss noch zur Post.

answers.answer_text: I have to go to the post office, too.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Ich will heute zum Zahnarzt.

answers.answer_text: I want to go to the dentist today.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Musst du noch zum Uhrmacher?

answers.answer_text: Do you have to go to the watchmaker's too?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Sie will heute nachmittag zum Frisör.

answers.answer_text: She wants to go to the hairdresser's this afternoon.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Ein Herr von der englischen Botschaft will Sie sprechen.

answers.answer_text: A gentleman from the British Embassy wants to talk to you.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Darf ich bitte Herrn Dr. Bergmann sprechen?

answers.answer_text: May I please talk to Dr. Bergmann?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Ich möchte gern Herrn Professor Albers sprechen.

answers.answer_text: I'd like to talk to Professor Albers.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wollen Sie Herrn Konsul Wilson sprechen?

answers.answer_text: Do you wish to speak to Consul Wilson?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Ich muss Herrn Wachtmeister König sprechen.

answers.answer_text: I must speak to Officer König.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Kann ich Ihren Herrn Kollegen sprechen?

answers.answer_text: Can I talk to your colleague?
